notes: EmbeddingGemma 2 Transcribe, LiteRT form: the audio encoder of google/embeddinggemma-2 (rev 914f7f89; Gemma 4 audio tower + embed_audio) exported to raw LiteRT graphs with an fp16-safe rewrite of its RMSNorm sites (per-site 2^-k rescale, eps x 4^-k, rsqrt clamp, attention mask -30000; bit-identical to the float32 model in fp32), fp16 weights (FLOAT_CASTING on FC / CONV_2D / DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D), one signature per file (audio_30s / audio_10s: mel float32 [1, F, 128] + mask -> soft tokens [1, F/4, 512] + mask), plus reader v1 (a 4-layer transformer over the soft tokens with the 200,000-word table FC and ARG_MAX in-graph) = speech to words on the phone. This file: eg2_audio_f16safe_fp16w_w30.tflite (589273696 B), sha256 = hf_stage FILES.sha256 of the upload set; every phone leg below ran these bytes (sha256 lines in the evidence). Pixel 8a (8 GB): GPU legs through the gate app; the fp32-weight copy of the same rewrite is not given to this GPU (1.17 GB). FP16_WITH_FP32_ACCUM passes the 7-row subset and fails the 41-window whole set at quiet, non-silent tokens of the long recording; FP32 passes. Lane record: litertlm-convert eg2_stt_work (LANE.md, ROUND1–11, SPEED_LADDER.md lint PASS with user-stop 2026-10-14). Landed 2026-10-15 (DECISIONS #216): the file is on the Hub at mlboydaisuke/EmbeddingGemma-2-Transcribe-LiteRT (upload commit 54d0e902cd50bd6f04958a81ab93e02bf5c77b9d = main, 2026-10-14 18:00:44 UTC = 2026-10-15 03:00 JST); its LFS oid equals artifact_sha256 (anonymous API read 2026-10-15 03:08 JST).
